blocks.text: THE VITAL GENERATION- We're living in the most dangerous and unusual times in the history of the world. This generation has never seen such vital prophecy revealing we’re turning the corner towards the coming of Christ and the great tribulation. Every facet of this planet is changing as predicted. It has been like a flood of events, as the prophets said, ending the age. We will have more of the same, only worse. Scientists are baffled by all the strange phenomenon concerning under earth, on the earth and in the heavens. As Daniel said, knowledge shall increase and we’re in the age of super intelligence. Later, which will seem to bring peace, but bring nearly annihilation. God is uniting His real Elect at this moment. Not only will the unexpected be among His children, but the world will be caught off guard in a subtle snare wherein the lamb turns into a dragon.

We're seeing revolutionary events concerning society and the four elements. You might say, the world has not seen anything yet and will be ill prepared for what is ahead. But the joy of the Lord will be with His real believers! They will not follow the imitation arising at this hour, but will stay with the Word and real Spirit. The midnight cry is here and the thunders are rolling! The world will be in confusion, but the Elect will receive renewed knowledge, power, faith and an outpouring of His Spirit. We will be wrapped up in a rainbow and leave!

The economics came out just as predicted, and the weather plus how society would act. The violence is incredible-wars and rumors of wars. And terrorism will rise again. And even at this time has been involved in some tragedies they cannot pinpoint. They said weather patterns have broken all type of records that you can imagine, in surprising ways. And the immorals have broken all records. What they have done can hardly be imagined or written.

They have seen bazaar and fascinating glowing lights in the heavens. - Also a sign of His coming. Here’s a promise to His Elect in Zech. 10:1, “Ask ye of the Lord rain in the time of the latter rain, so the Lord shall make bright clouds, and give then showers of rain, to everyone grass in the field.” So be alert and drink and eat of this manna!

BEAUTIFUL PASSAGES OF REVELATION AND KNOWLEDGE- Rev. 21:4, “And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.” Verse 5, “And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.” Verse 6-This part reveals who He is and his love, mercy and goodness... “And he said unto me, It is done. 1am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.” Verse 7, “He that over cometh shall inherit all things; and 1 will be his God and he shall be my son.” You don’t want any part of Verse 8 where it speaks of the second death... “But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murders, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake, which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.” But let’s go back and read this revelation in Verse 1 - ‘And Isaw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.”
NATIONAL CALAMITIES- We have certainly seen God’s wake up trumpet

with the cataclysms that took place in the USA on 9-11-2001 up until Jan.-Mar.2002. Also before all this different events took place, concerning politics, economics and society, 1 wrote this on a script (#281). Quote: THE UNVEILING- This subject will involve the spiritual to the real believer and also it will concern important events concerning the nation! (It concerns exposure.) “The unseen shall be seen. The hidden shall be revealed, the unknown, known. The unheard shall be heard.” Events kept secret will come to the forefront and bring drastic changes to the U.S.A. and world now and 2001-2002, etc. The subterfuge will rise. Unexpected shock waves coming. The celestial phenomenon also bears witness to this. Concerning the spiritual, the Elect will receive the final secrets concerning the Thunders, translation and resurrection. He is already moving in that direction. “Soon time shall be no more here for the believer as they leave into another dimension.” God gave me this. This is a true parable. It covers both sides, the materialistic world and the spiritual. Watch and pray!

THE CELESTIAL- Some amazing conjunctions and oppositions will occur in the next few years in the constellation of Pisces and Gemini and moon sign under constellation of Cancer bringing about cycles of drastic and tremendous changes and movements of people concerning this planet. Also like the first decade of the 1900’s, in the first decade of 2000’s we will witness not only cataclysmic but awesome occurrences. (Read Ps. 19) Before it ends some unusual eclipses etc., occur. More on this later.

GOD’S TRADEMARK- Just as Satan has a trademark of violence, destruction and desolation, unbelief, etc. God’s trademark is on His children - love, joy, peace. - Gal. 5:22-23, “But the fruit of the Sprit is love, joy, peace, long suffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.” Paul even states these are even more valuable than the gifts. And for most people it’s hard to keep a few of the fruits let alone all of them. Cor. 13:1, “Though I speak with the tongues of men and angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.” Also read verses 2-13.

FALLOUT- The USA and the whole planet has been upset, perplexed and confused about the terrorists and terrible events occurring lately. They have been so terrorized they’re terrorizing themselves. But don’t think for a minute that the terrorists have stopped because not only it and powerful things will occur. The unexpected will be the norm.

Black Hawk Down was a film of a war document where horrifying events took place - tragedies. — But to us it’s White Eagle Up! This scripture is closing in on us and shall be soon past history. - Isa. 40:31, “But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk and not faint.”
